title: Jammy Juicy Italian Cheese Cannoli
description: A festive Italian dish featuring red curry paste and cheese pull, served in a cannoli form on a cedar plank, with an ayurvedic-rajasic friendly twist.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the ricotta cheese, red curry paste, and confectioners sugar, and mix until smooth.
Stir in the chopped pistachios and dried cranberries.
Spoon the cheese mixture into a piping bag fitted with a large round tip.
Pipe the cheese mixture into the cannoli shells, filling them about 3/4 of the way full.
Place the filled cannoli shells on the soaked cedar planks, leaving about 1 inch of space between each shell.
Drizzle the melted butter over the cannoli shells.
Bake the cannoli for 12 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and the shells are golden brown.
Remove the cannoli from the oven and let them cool for 5 minutes.
Serve the cannoli warm, topped with a spoonful of jam and a sprinkle of chopped fresh basil.
